question: What uneven fault in their sight is attributed before radiant illumination?
premises: A fault is identified as this and uneven
The fault belongs to their sight and is of such a kind
inference: Their sight has such an uneven fault in relation to radiant illumination
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of bhāsvaddyota to the rest of the sentence is compressed
plain_english: O radiant illumination, that fault is this uneven one, such is the fault of their sight.
